subject: Aids to Navigation - Lake Erie - East end
text:
Aids to Navigation - Lake Erie - East end
Privately maintained orange and white mooring buoy with flashing amber light and radar reflector placed for the navigational season to mark the shipwreck "Stonewreck" at 42 40.076N 079 23.780W.
                                                    Cancels NW-C-2219-26
